definitions.explanation: the gradual destruction or degradation of materials (especially metals) by chemical reaction

examples.japanese: {金属|きんぞく}が{腐食|ふしょく}する。
{腐食|ふしょく}を{防|ふせ}ぐために{塗装|とそう}する。
examples.english: To paint in order to prevent corrosion.

examples.japanese: {配管|はいかん}の{腐食|ふしょく}が{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: Corrosion of the pipes is advancing.

notes:
{腐食|ふしょく} refers to the chemical degradation of materials.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {腐|ふ} (rot, decay, corrode)
- {食|しょく} (eat, erode)

TYPES OF CORROSION:
- {電気|でんき}{腐食|ふしょく}/{電食|でんしょく} (electrolytic corrosion)
- {化学|かがく}{腐食|ふしょく} (chemical corrosion)
- {応力|おうりょく}{腐食|ふしょく} (stress corrosion)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {腐食|ふしょく}{防止|ぼうし} (corrosion prevention)
- {腐食|ふしょく}{性|せい} (corrosive property)
- {耐|たい}{腐食|ふしょく}{性|せい} (corrosion resistance)
- {腐食|ふしょく}{剤|ざい} (corrosive agent)

USAGE:
- {腐食|ふしょく}する (to corrode - suru verb)
- {腐食|ふしょく}させる (to cause corrosion)

RELATED TERMS:
- {錆|さび} (rust)
- {酸化|さんか} (oxidation)
- {劣化|れっか} (deterioration)
